name: autofeature
description: Build an entire feature end-to-end from a single prompt. Pipeline: interrogate → scope → product-review → plan → branch → implement (parallel specialists) → test → review → ship. Review lenses unified under /review [product|feature|market|scope]: /product-review (CEO/PM/flow-walker whole-product gaps & flows), /feature-review (focused opinion + build advice for one feature), /market-review (market demand, competitive gap & VC fundability with cited, re-verified research), /scope. Also /fullrun (deploy verification) and /seo (SEO audit + fix).
